text:
maria: quick sync — attaching the draft PRD for the quota & billing work. need scope call before EOW. main asks: clear metering semantics, UI acceptance, and launch SLOs. link: https://redwood.internal/prd/quota-billing-draft

jonathan: thanks. skimmed. question — do we treat embeddings and text tokens under the same quota bucket?

maria: good call. proposal in doc: separate buckets for embeddings vs generation, but a unified rate limit per project to avoid surprise spikes. open to tradeoffs.

linda-billing: from pricing side we prefer per-unit metering only (tokens / embedding-units). per-project rate limit OK but must be decoupled from invoiceable unit to avoid double-billing edge cases.

alex-eng: ops note: per-project rate limits mean we need a lightweight routing layer change. can prototype with feature-flag. also need clear 429 semantics (retry-after vs quota-exceeded reason).

sre-jen: agree on 429 details. also need a fallback policy for Dedicated customers: when host quota exhausted, we should route to dedicated pool or degrade to smaller model. PRD should list fallback order.

maria: added acceptance criteria section in doc. pasted below. please comment inline if missing anything.

maria: ```Acceptance criteria:
- Metering: tokens and embedding-units recorded and visible per API key & org
- Billing: usage exported hourly to billing pipeline, no >5% variance vs sampling in first 30 days
- Rate limits: 429 responses include machine-readable JSON with fields: {"code":"quota_exceeded", "retry_after": int}
- UI: limits page shows current quota, usage %, top 5 consumers, and button to request raise
- SLO: <1% false-positive quota blocks during ramp (false-positive = blocked but usage actually below quota)
```

design-lee: UI mockups look good. small ask: add a tooltip explaining embedding-units equivalence.

linda-billing: edge-case: customers doing bulk embedding jobs (thousands of items) — need batch pricing guidance + metering at job-level to avoid hundreds of tiny billing events.

jonathan: for batch jobs we can expose a job_id param and aggregate meter events server-side into a single invoiceable record. low-effort.

alex-eng: implementation note: job_id aggregation should be opt-in for first version. requires a small addition to the metering service and billing ETL.

maria: scope proposal for MVP (pick 2 of 3: metering, UI, fallback):
- MVP A: Full metering + billing export, minimal UI (usage numbers only)
- MVP B: Full UI + basic metering (no job aggregation), delayed billing export
- MVP C: Rate limits + fallback policies, basic metering
Which do we prefer? call for votes. :raised_hand:

sre-jen: vote C (prioritize reliability & graceful degradation)

linda-billing: vote A (billing correctness is critical for sales conversations)

jonathan: vote A (billing first), but agree C for Dedicated customers in parallel if we can allocate 1 eng.

alex-eng: we can run parallel track: A mainline + small spike for C fallback. need 2 sprints for metering export.

maria: thanks. action items I captured:
- maria: update PRD with job_id aggregation as opt-in (due Tue)
- jonathan: spike on routing changes for per-project rate-limits (due Fri)
- alex-eng: estimate metering export work (due Wed)
- design-lee: add embedding tooltip + small copy edits (due Thu)
- linda-billing: write billing edge-case doc for bulk jobs (due Thu)

pm-bot: Reminder: PRD review due in 3 days — please add inline comments.

maria: if nobody objects, I'll lock to MVP A + parallel spike for C and present to leadership next Wed. objections?

linda-billing: no objection, +1

jonathan: +1

sre-jen: +1 on the parallel spike, prefer gating the fallback behind feature-flag for safety.

alex-eng: +1

maria: great — locking. I'll post updated thread when PRD is revised. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
